tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'bum na pa bzhugs so/ /

༄༅/ /shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ glegs bam bcu gnyis pa/ bam po dang po/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar gzugs la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /tshor ba la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /'du shes la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /'du byed la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /myig la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rna ba la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /sna la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /lce la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /lus

la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /yid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /gzugs la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /sgra la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /dri la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /ro la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /reg la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /chos la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa la rang bzhin myed

de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la rang bzhin myed de gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la rang bzhin myed de/gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /sa'i khams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /chu'i khams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /mye'i khams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rlung gi khams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /nam mkha'i khams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /ma rig pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /'du byed la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni

brjod du myed pa'o/ /mying dang gzugs la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /skye mched drug la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /reg pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /tshor ba la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /sred pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /len pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /srid pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /skye ba la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rga shi la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /nang stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /phyi stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la rang bzhin

myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /chen po stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la Rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi

rkang pa rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /dbang po rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /stobs rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /bsam gtan rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /tshad myed pa rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ /gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rnam par thar ba brgyad la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /mngon par shes pa rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /so so yang

dag par rig pa bzhi la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /byams pa chen po la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /snying rje chen po la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /dgra bcom pa nyid la rang bzhi ni myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rang byang chub la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rang bzhin myed de/ gang la rang bzhin myed pa de ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i skyon myed pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i skyon myed par zhugs pa ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa de ni ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i dbang gis kyang myi skye na/ 'dod chags sam/ zhe sdang ngam/ gti mug gis skye bar 'gyur zhing de la gnas te/ de'i las mngon par 'du byed pa dang / las de mngon par 'du byas pas 'gro ba lnga'i 'khor bar ltung bar 'gyur ba lta ci smos te/ de ni gnas myed do/ /gzhan du na sgyu ma lta bu'i chos rnams la gnas shing / sems can thams cad kyi don byed de/ sems can nam sgyu mar yang dmyigs pa myed do/ /de sems can dang

sgyu ma myi dmyigs pas/ sems can rnams yongs su smyin par byed cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su 'dzin te/ rab 'byor de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ ting nge 'dzin gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byas nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bar du ste/ myi dmyigs pa'i 'khor lo dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i 'khor lo bskor ro/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos thams cad rmyi lam lta bur yongs su shes so/ /chos thams cad sgra brnyan lta bur yongs su shes so/ /chos thams cad myig yor lta bur yongs su shes so/ /chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur yongs su shes so/ /chos thams cad smyig rgyu lta bur yongs su shes so/ /chos thams cad sprul pa lta bur yongs su shes so/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe ji ltar na chos thams cad rmyi lam lta bur yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su 'tshal ba lags/ ji ltar na chos thams cad sgra brnyan lta bur yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su 'tshal ba lags/ ji ltar na chos thams cad myig yor lta bur yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su 'tshal ba lags/ ji ltar na chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su 'tshal ba lags/ ji ltar na chos thams cad smig rgyu lta bur yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su 'tshal ba lags/ ji ltar na chos thams cad sprul pa lta bur yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su 'tshal ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rmyi lam myi mthong ngo / /rmyi lam mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sgra brnyan myi thos so/ /sgra brnyan nyan pa myi mthong ngo / /myig yor myi

mthong ngo / myig yor mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sgyu ma myi mthong ngo / /sgyu ma mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /smyig rgyu myi mthong ngo / /smyig rgyu mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sprul pa myi mthong ngo / /sprul pa mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams kyi rmyi lam ni phyin ci log go /sgra brnyan ni phyin ci log go /myig yor ni phyin ci log go /sgyu ma ni phyin ci log go /smyig rgyu ni phyin ci log go /sprul pa ni phyin ci log go/ dgra bcom pa ni rmyi lam myi mthong ngo / /rmyi lam mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sgra brnyan myi thos so/ /sgra brnyan nyan pa myi mthong ngo / /myig yor myi mthong ngo / /myig yor mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sgyu ma myi mthong ngo / /sgyu ma mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /smyig rgyu myi mthong ngo / /smyig rgyu mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sprul pa myi mthong ngo / /sprul pa mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /rang sangs rgyas ni rmyi lam myi mthong ngo / /rmyi lam mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sgra brnyan myi thos so/ /sgra brnyan nyan pa myi mthong ngo / /myig yor myi mthong ngo / /myig yor mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sgyu ma myi mthong ngo / /sgyu ma mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /smyig rgyu myi mthong ngo / /smyig rgyu mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sprul pa myi mthong ngo / /sprul pa mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' ni rmyi lam myi mthong ngo / /rmyi lam mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sgra brnyan myi thos so/ /sgra brnyan nyan pa myi mthong ngo / /myig yor myi mthong ngo / /myig yor mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sgyu ma myi mthong ngo / /sgyu ma mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /smyig rgyu myi mthong ngo / /smyig rgyu mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /sprul pa myi mthong ngo / /sprul pa mthong ba myi mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni rmi lam myi gzigs so/ /rmyi lam mthong ba myi gzigs so/ /sgra brnyan myi gsan no/ /sgra brnyan nyan pa myi gzigs so/ /myig yor myi gzigs so/ /myig yor mthong ba myi gzigs so/ /sgyu ma myi gzigs so/ /sgyu ma mthong ba myi gzigs so/ /smyig rgyu myi

gzigs so/ /smyig rgyu mthong ba myi gzigs so/ /sprul pa myi gzigs so/ /sprul pa mthong ba myi gzigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar yang dag pa ma yin pas/ chos thams cad ni dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid de/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang mnyam pa ste/ yang dag pa ma yin pa'i phyir chos thams cad yongs su grub pa myed na/ de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ dngos po'i 'du shes sam/ yongs su grub pa'i 'du shes sam/ yang dag pa'i 'du shes su 'gyur ba lta ga la yod de/ de ni gnas myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gal te chos la la zhig gi ngo bo nyid dam/ yongs su grub pa'am/ yang dag par gyur pa zhig dmyigs na ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par yang myi 'gyur te/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar spyod na/ gzugs la chags pa myed do/ /tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /'du shes la chags pa myed do/ /'du byed la chags pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /khams rnams la chags pa myed do/ /skye mched rnams la chags pa myed do/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la chags pa myed do/ /'dod pa'i khams la chags pa myed do/ /gzugs kyi khams la chags pa myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i khams la chags pa myed do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /nang stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid la chags

pa myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams la chags pa myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /dbang po rnams la chags pa myed do/ /stobs rnams la chags pa myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la chags pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la chags pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /bsam gtan rnams la chags pa myed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad la chags pa myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la chags pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la chags pa myed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams la chags pa myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams la chags pa myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la chags pa myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /byams pa chen po la chags pa myed do/ /

snying rje chen po la chags pa myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la chags pa myed do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la chags pa myed do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la chags pa myed do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /rang byang chub la chags pa myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gnas shing / sa dang po yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags myi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des sa de yang myi dmyigs na/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyed par lta ga la 'gyur te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gnas shing sa gnyis pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags myi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des sa de yang myi dmyigs na/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyed par lta ga la 'gyur te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gnas shing sa gsum pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags myi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des sa de yang myi dmyigs na/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyed par lta ga la 'gyur te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gnas shing sa bzhi ba yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags myi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des sa de yang myi dmyigs na/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyed par lta ga la 'gyur te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gnas shing / sa lnga pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags myi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des sa de yang myi dmyigs na/ de 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyed par lta ga la 'gyur/ de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di

la gnas shing / sa drug pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags myi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des sa de yang myi dmyigs na/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyed par lta ga la 'gyur te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gnas shing / sa bdun pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags myi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des sa de yang myi dmyigs na/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyed par lta ga la 'gyur te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gnas shing / sa brgyad pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags myi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des sa de yang myi dmyigs na/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyed par lta ga la 'gyur te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gnas shing / sa dgu pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags myi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des sa de yang myi dmyigs na/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyed par lta ga la 'gyur te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gnas shing / sa bcu pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags myi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des sa de yang myi dmyigs na/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags skyed par lta ga la 'gyur te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la gnas shing / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de yang myi dmyigs so/ /de myi dmyigs pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa der chos thams cad kyang 'dus par mthong ste/ chos de dag kyang myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar chos de dag dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de la gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar chos de dag ni tha dad du bya ba gang yang myed de/ chos kyi dbyings su bstan pa dang / de bzhin nyid du bstan pa dang / yang dag pa'i

mthar bstan pas/ chos thams cad dbyer myed do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar chos thams cad dbyer ma mchis pa lags na/ ji ltar dge ba dang myi dge ba'i chos rnams bstan pa lags/ ji ltar 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rnams bstan pa lags/ ji ltar zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa ma mchis pa'i chos rnams bstan pa lags/ ji ltar 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams bstan pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de la 'dus byas sam/ 'dus ma byas sam/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'am/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'am/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid dam/ rang byang chub bam/ byang chub sems dpa' gang yang brjod du yod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas na khyod kyis rnam grangs des 'di ltar chos thams cad dbyer myed pa dang / chos thams cad mtshan nyid myed pa dang / skye ba myed pa dang / 'byung ba myed par rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor nga sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs shes bya ba'am/ tshor ba zhes bya ba 'am/ 'du shes zhes bya ba 'am/ 'du byed ces bya ba 'am/ rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'am/ myig ces bya ba 'am/ rna ba zhes bya ba 'am/ sna zhes bya ba 'am/ lce zhes bya ba 'am/ lus shes bya ba 'am/ yid ces bya ba 'am/ gzugs shes bya ba 'am/ sgra zhes bya ba 'am/ dri zhes bya ba 'am/ ro zhes bya ba 'am/ reg ces bya ba 'am/ chos shes bya ba 'am/ myig gi rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'am/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'am/ sna'i rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'am/ lce'i rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'am/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'am/ yid kyi rnam par

shes pa zhes bya ba 'am/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba 'am/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba 'am/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba 'am/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba 'am/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba 'am/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba 'am/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba 'am/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba 'am/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba 'am/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba 'am/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba 'am/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba 'am/ sa'i khams shes bya ba 'am/ chu'i khams shes bya ba 'am/ mye'i khams shes bya ba 'am/ rlung gi khams shes bya ba 'am/ nam mkha'i khams shes bya ba 'am/ rnam par shes pa'i khams shes bya ba 'am/ ma rig pa zhes bya ba 'am/ 'du byed ces bya ba 'am/ rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'am/ mying dang gzugs shes bya ba 'am/ skye mched drug ces bya ba 'am/ reg pa zhes bya ba 'am/ tshor ba zhes bya ba 'am/ sred pa zhes bya ba 'am/ len pa zhes bya ba 'am/ srid pa zhes bya ba 'am/ skye ba zhes bya ba 'am/ rga shi zhes bya ba 'am/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba 'am/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba 'am/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba 'am/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba 'am/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba 'am/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba 'am/ nang stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'am/ phyi stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'am/ phyi nang stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'am/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'am/ chen po stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'am/ don dam pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'am/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'am/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid

ces bya ba 'am/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'am/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'am/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'am/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'am/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'am/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'am/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'am/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'am/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'am/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams shes bya ba 'am/ yang dag par spong ba rnams shes bya ba 'am/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams shes bya ba 'am/ dbang po rnams shes bya ba 'am/ stobs rnams shes bya ba 'am/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams shes bya ba 'am/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa zhes bya ba 'am/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams shes bya ba 'am/ bsam gtan rnams shes bya ba 'am/ tshad myed pa rnams shes bya ba 'am/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams shes bya ba 'am/ rnam par thar pa brgyad ces bya ba 'am/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu zhes bya ba 'am/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa rnams shes bya ba 'am/ mngon par shes pa rnams shes bya ba 'am/ ting nge 'dzin rnams shes bya ba 'am/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams shes bya ba 'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu zhes bya ba 'am/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi zhes bya ba 'am/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi zhes bya ba 'am/ byams pa chen po zhes bya ba 'am/ snying rje chen po zhes bya ba 'am/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad ces bya ba 'am/ dge ba'i chos rnams shes bya ba 'am/ myi dge ba'i chos rnams shes bya ba 'am/ nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa'i chos rnams shes bya ba 'am/ nyon

mongs pa myed pa'i chos rnams shes bya ba 'am/ 'jig rten pa'i chos rnams shes bya ba 'am/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rnams shes bya ba 'am/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos rnams shes bya ba 'am/ zag pa myed pa'i chos rnams shes bya ba 'am/ thun mong gi chos rnams shes bya ba 'am/ thun mong ma yin pa'i chos rnams shes bya ba 'am/ 'dus byas kyi chos rnams shes bya ba 'am/ 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams shes bya ba 'am/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba 'am/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba 'am/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba 'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid ces bya ba 'am/ rang byang chub ces bya ba 'am/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ces bya ba 'am/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bya ba 'am/ chos gang gi rang bzhin yang mi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin la mkhas par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin la mkhas pa ni byang chub kyi lam yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /sems can rnams yongs su smyin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su 'dzin to/ /de la gnas te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ sems can rnams ci nas kyang dul bar gyur nas/ srid pa gsum na myi snang ba de ltar rnam par btul lo/ /rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos mtshan nyid myed pa'i tshul gyis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab par bya'o/ /

shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u drug cu gnyis so// //de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byord kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad rmyi lam lta bu dngos po ma mchis pa/ dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa rnams la 'di dag ni dge ba'i chos so/ /'di dag ni myi dge ba'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'jig rten pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni zag pa myed pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'dus byas kyi chos so/ /'di dag ni 'dus ma byas kyi chos so/ /'di dag ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni rang byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes bgyi bar ji ltar rnam par dgod par 'gyur/ chos thams cad sgra brnyan lta bu/ myig yor lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu/ smyig rgyu lta bu/ sprul pa lta bu/ dngos po ma mchis pa/ dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa rnams la/ 'di dag ni dge ba'i chos so/ /'di dag ni myi dge ba'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'jig rten pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni zag pa myed pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'dus byas kyi chos so/ /'di dag ni 'dus ma byas kyi chos so/ /'di dag ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras

bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni rang byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'o zhes bgyi bar ji ltar rnam par dgod par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byis pa thos pa dang / myi ldan pa so so'i skye bo ni rmyi lam yang dmyigs la/ rmyi lam mthong ba yang dmyigs so/ /sgra brnyan yang dmyigs la/ sgra brnyan nyan pa yang dmyigs so/ /myig yor yang dmyigs la/ myig yor mthong ba yang dmyigs so/ /sgyu ma yang dmyigs la/ sgyu ma mthong ba yang dmyigs so/ /smyig rgyu yang dmyigs la/ smyig rgyu mthong ba yang dmyigs so/ /sprul pa yang dmyigs la/ sprul pa mthong ba yang dmyigs so/ /des rmyi lam yang dmyigs/ rmyi lam mthong ba yang dmyigs/ sgra brnyan yang dmyigs/ sgra brnyan nyan pa yang dmyigs/ myig yor yang dmyigs/ myig yor mthong ba yang dmyigs/ sgyu ma yang dmyigs/ sgyu ma mthong ba yang dmyigs/ smig rgyu yang dmyigs/ smyig rgyu mthong ba yang dmyigs/ sprul pa yang dmyigs/ sprul pa mthong ba yang dmyigs nas/ lus dang ngag dang / yid kyis dge ba'i 'du bya ba yang mngon par 'du byed do/ /lus dang ngag dang / yid kyis myi dge ba'i 'du bya ba yang mngon par 'du byed do/ /de bzhin du lus dang ngag dang / yid kyis bsod nams dang / bsod nams ma yin pa dang / myi g.yo ba'i 'du bya ba yang mngon par 'du byed do/ /de bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa/ mtha'

las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong ba nyid dang / stong ba nyid gnyis la gnas shing / sems can rnams la chos ston te/ khams gsum 'di ni stong pa ste/ 'di la gzugs sam/ tshor ba 'am/ 'du shes sam/ 'du byed dam/ rnam par shes pa 'am/ phung po rnams sam/ khams rnams sam/ skye mched rnams myed do/ /'di ni rmyi lam/ 'di ni sgra brnyan/ 'di ni myig yor/ 'di ni sgyu ma/ 'di ni smyig rgyu/ 'di ni sprul pa ste/ 'di la phung po rnams sam/ khams rnams sam/ skye mched rnams myed do/ /'di la rmyi lam myed do/ /rmyi lam mthong ba myed do/ /sgra brnyan myed do/ /sgra brnyan nyan pa myed do/ /myigayor myed do/ /myig yor mthong ba myed do/ /sgyu ma myed do/ /sgyu ma byed pa myed do/ /smyig rgyu myed do/ /smig rgyu mthong ba myed do/ /sprul pa myed do/ /sprul pa byed pa myed do/ /chos 'di dag thams cad ni dngos po myed pa dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid yin na/ 'on kyang khyed ni phung po myed pa la phung por 'du shes pa/ khams myed pa la kha mas su 'du shes pa/ skye mched myed pa la skye mched du 'du shes pa dag ste/ chos 'di dag thams cad ni rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba phyin ci log las skyes pa/ las kyi rnam par smin pas yongs su bzung ba yin na/ khyed rnams ci'i phyir chos thams cad dngos po myed pa la dngos po'i 'du shes su byed ces te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ thabs mkhas pas sems can ser sna can dag ser sna las rnam par bzlog nas/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyor te/ sbyin pa yongs su btang ba de yang de dag la longs spyod chen po'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /des de dag de las bskyod nas/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu

phyin pa la sbyor te/ tshul khrims yang dag par blangs pa de yang de dag la mtho ris su skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /des de dag de las bskyod nas/ ting nge 'dzin la sbyor te/ ting nge 'dzin de yang de dag la tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /des de dag de las bskyod nas/ bsam gtan dang po la sbyor te/ bsam gtan dang po las bskyod nas bsam gtan gnyis pa la sbyor ro/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa las bskyod nas/ bsam gtan gsum pa la sbyor ro/ /bsam gtan gsum pa las bskyod nas/ bsam gtan bzhi ba la sbyor ro/ /bsam gtan bzhi ba las bskyod nas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa la sbyor ro/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa las bskyod nas/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa la sbyor ro/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa las bskyod nas/ chung zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa la sbyor ro/ /chung zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa las bskyod nas/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa la sbyor ro/ /des sbyin pa dang sbyin pa'i 'bras bu dma' ba de las rnam grangs du mas bskyod de/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su dbugs 'byin to/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /des tshul khrims dang / tshul khrims kyi 'bras bu de las rnam grangs du mas bskyod de/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su rab tu gzhog go /des ting nge 'dzin dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi 'bras bu de las rnam grangs du mas bskyod de/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su rab tu gzhog go /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul

lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /yang dag par spong ba bzhi la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba bzhi la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /dbang po lnga la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /stobs lnga la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng bstod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng bstod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /bsam gtan bzhi la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /tshad myed pa bzhi la yang

dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi la yang

dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /so so yang dag par rig par rig pa bzhi la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /byams pa chen po la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /snying rje chen po la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad la yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /de zag pa myed pa'i chos gzugs myed pa/ bstan du myed pa thogs pa myed pa de dag gis gang rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu don du gnyer ba de dag rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la rab tu 'god do/ /gang lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu don du gnyer ba de dag lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu 'god do/ /gang phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu don du gnyer ba de dag phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu 'god do/ /gang dgra bcom pa nyid don du gnyer ba de dag dgra bcom pa nyid la rab tu 'god do/ /gang rang byang chub don du gnyer ba de dag rang byang chub la rab tu 'god do/ /gang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba de dag la byang chub kyi lam brjod cing ston to/ /yang dag par skul lo/ /yang dag par gzeng stod do/ /yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /'dul

lo/ /gzhog go/ rab tu 'god do/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos thams cad rmi lam lta bu dang / sgra brnyan lta bu dang chu zla lta bu dang myig yor lta bu dang / sgyu ma lta bu dang / smyig rgyu lta bu dang / sprul ba lta bu ste/ dngos po myed pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa la rnam par dgod par byed do/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos thams cad dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / chos thams cad mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma ma mchis pa stong pa nyid la 'di dag ni dge ba'i chos so/ /'di dag ni myi dge ba'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'jig rten pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni kha na ma tho ba myed pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni zag pa myed pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'dus ma byas kyi chos so/ /'di dag ni 'dus ma byas kyi chos so/ /'di dag ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni phyir myi 'ong pa'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni rang byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes ba gyi bar rnam

par dgod par bgyid pa ni ngo mtshar te/ rmad du byung ba'i chos so/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor de de bzhin no de de bzhin te/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos thams cad dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / chos thams cad mtha' las 'das pa stong ba nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la 'di dag ni dge ba'i chos so/ /'di dag ni myi dge ba'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'jig rten pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni kha na ma tho ba myed pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni zag pa myed pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'dus byas kyi chos so/ /'di dag ni 'dus ma byas kyi chos so/ /'di dag ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni rang byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes bya bar rnam par dgod pa byed pa de ni ngo mtshar te/ rmad du byung ba'i chos so/ /rab 'byor gal te khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gi ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos de shes kyang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems

dpa' chen po de la slar phan gdags par bya ba sla ba ma yin te/ khyed cag thams cad kyis kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i chos de zil gyis gnan par myi nus so/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad la ma mchis pa'i ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la mchis pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de'i phyir shin tu legs par nyon la yid la gyis shig dang bshad par bya'o/ /rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i stong pa nyid thams cad la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i bsam gtan bzhi la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i tshad myed pa bzhi la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i rnam par thar pa brgyad la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i mngon par shes pa lnga la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin rnams la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i gzungs kyi sgo rnams la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i myi 'jigs pa bzhi la gnas/

rnam par smyin pa las byung ba'i sa so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i byams pa chen po la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i snying rje chen po la gnas/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad la gnas shing / phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams dag tu song zhing / sems can gang la sbyin pas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni sbyin pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la tshul khrims kyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni tshul khrims kyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la bzod pas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni bzod pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la brtson 'grus kyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni brtson 'grus kyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la ting nge 'dzin gyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni ting nge 'dzin gyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la shes rab kyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni shes rab kyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la bsam gtan dang pos phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni bsam gtan dang pos phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la bsam gtan gnyis pas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni bsam gtan gnyis pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la bsam gtan gsum pas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni bsam gtan gsum pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la bsam gtan bzhi pas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni bsam gtan bzhi pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can

gang la rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la chung zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ chung zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la byams pas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni byams pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la snying rjes phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni snying rjes phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la dga' bas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni dga' bas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la btang snyoms kyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni btang snyoms kyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la yang dag par spong ba bzhis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ yang dag par spong ba bzhis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la dbang po lngas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni dbang po lngas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la stobs lngas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni stobs lngas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la 'phags pa'i lam

yan lag brgyad pas phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pas phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la rnam par thar pa brgyad kyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ rnam par thar pa brgyad kyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgus phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgus phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la mtshan ma myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ mtshan ma myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la smon pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ smon pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la mngon par shes pa rnams kyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la ting nge 'dzin dang/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcus phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcus phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la myi 'jigs pa bzhis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ myi 'jigs pa bzhis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la so so yang dag par rig pa bzhis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhis phan

'dogs so/ /sems can gang la sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad kyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad kyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la snying rje chen pos phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni snying rje chen pos phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la thams cad shes pa nyid kyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ thams cad shes pa nyid kyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyis phan 'dogs so/ /sems can gang la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis phan gdags par bya ba de dag la ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis phan 'dogs so/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pas sems can rnams la sman 'dogs pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ zas 'dod pa rnams la zas/ skom 'dod pa rnams la skom/ bzhon pa 'dod pa rnams la bzhon pa/ phreng ba 'dod pa rnams la phreng ba/ spos 'dod pa rnams la spos/ byug pa 'dod pa rnams la byug pa/ gos 'dod pa rnams la gos/ mal cha 'dod pa rnams la mal cha/ gnas 'dod pa rnams la gnas/ nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bai ḍūr+ya dang / dung dang / man shel dang / byi ru dang / gser dang / dngul 'dod pa rnams la/ nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bai ḍūr+ya dang / dung dang / man shel dang / byi ru dang / gser dang / dngul gyi sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba nas/ myi'i yo byad gang yang rung ba'i bar du yongs su gtong ste/ ji ltar

de bzhin gshegs pa/ dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la dbul zhing yongs su gtong ba dang / ji ltar rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / dgra bcom pa rnams dang / phyir myi 'ong ba rnams dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams dang / yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la yongs su gtong ba de bzhin du/ myir gyur pa rnams dang / de bzhin du byol song gi skye gnas su gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad la yang tha dad du bya ba myed pa'i 'du shes nye bar bzhag cing sbyin pa yongs su gtong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar chos thams cad ni tha dad du bya ba myed pa ste/ des tha dad du bya ba myed pa'i sbyin pa byin pas/ tha dad du bya ba myed pa'i chos 'di lta ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos byol song gi skye gnas su gtogs pa'i srog chags sbyin pa'i gnas ma yin par mthong nas/ 'di snyam du/ bdag gi sbyin gnas ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ byol song gi skye gnas su gtogs pa ma yin no snyam na/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ni byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ 'di ltar bdag gis sems can 'di dag la ni sbyin pas phan gdags par bya'o/ /'di dag la ni phan gdags par myi bya'o/ /zhes bya bar bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs pa ma yin te/ de dag sbyin pas phan btags nas/ rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba'i rigs su skye/ bram ze che zhing mtho ba'i rigs su skye/ khyim bdag che zhing mtho ba'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur te/ sbyin pa de nyid kyis phan btags

pa de dag theg pa gsum gyis rim gyis phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das par 'gyur ro/ /gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la skye bo'i tshogs thams cad kyis gsad par gsol ba btab na/ de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sbyin no snyam 'am/ myi sbyin no snyam pa'i sems gzhan bskyed par myi bya'i/ /'khrug pa myed pa'i sems kyis skye bo'i tshogs de dag la sbyin par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de ni sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs pa'i phyir/ gal te de ltar rnam par rtog na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / dgra bcom pa rnams dang / slob pa rnams dang / lha dang / myi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten kyis smad par 'gyur te/ de la thog mar sems can thams cad kyi mgon gyis shig ce 'am/ gnas dang / skyabs dang / dpung gnyen gyis shig ces sus gsol ba btab btab ces smad par 'gyur te/ rab 'byor gzhan yang gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du myir gyur pa 'am/ myi ma yin par gyur pa dag 'ongs nas/ bdag ni slong mo pa'o zhes yan lag dang / nying lag gcad par gsol ba btab na/ de'i tshe des sbyin nam myi sbyin snyam pa'i sems gnyis su bskyed par myi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des sems can rnams kyi don du ched du bsams te/ lus 'dis bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don bya'o zhes lus yongs su bzung bas na/ des 'di snyam du bdag gis sems can

'di dag gi don du lus yongs su bzung bzung bas de dag bslang myi dgos pas khyer zhing dengs shig ces sems bskyed par byas te/ rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos slongs mo ba mthong na 'di snyam du chos 'di dag thams cad kyi rang bzhin dmyigs su myed na/ 'di la su zhig ni sbyin pa yongs su gtong / su la ni sbyin par bya/ ci zhig ni sbyin par bya zhes sems bskyed par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar chos de dag ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyis stong pa ste/ stong pa nyid la ni gang la yang yongs su gtong ba 'am/ gang las kyang 'phrogs pa myed do/ /rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / 'di lta ste/ nang stong pa nyid dam/ phyi stong pa nyid dam/ phyi nang stong pa nyid dam/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dam/ chen po stong pa nyid dam/ don dam pa stong pa nyid dam/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid dam/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dam/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dam/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dam/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dam/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid dam/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid dam/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dam/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dam/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dam/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dam/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la bslab par bya'o/ /de stong pa nyid de dag la gnas shing / sbyin pa gtong na/ de'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad par yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ de sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa des/ phyi dang nang gi chos la gcad cing gtubs kyang / bdag la su yang gtub pa 'am/ gcad do/

snyam pa'i sems myi 'byung ngo // //shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po gnyis pa/ rab 'byor ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag ched du bsams te/ sems can dmyal ba chen po dag tu dong zhing / sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byas nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang / yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul gsum po de dag gis sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag la chos ston cing / rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyis sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal de de dag zhi bar byas te/ yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis chos ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen pos chos ston te/ des sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la sems mos par byas shing / sems can dmyal ba chen po de dag nas rnam par ldang ba dang / de dag sems can dmyal ba chen po de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ lha dang myi dag dang skal ba mnyam par skyes shing / rim gyis theg pa gsum gyis sdug bsngal mthar 'byin pa mthong ngo / /rab 'byord ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag ched du bsams te/ sems can dmyal ba chen po dag tu dong zhing / sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byas nas/ rdzu

'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang / yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul gsum po de dag gis sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag la chos ston cing / rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyis sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal de dag zhi bar byas te/ yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis chos ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen pos chos ston te/ des sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la sems mos par byas shing / sems can dmyal ba chen po de dag nas rnam par ldang ba dang / de dag sems can dmyal ba chen po de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ lha dang myi dag dang skal ba mnyam par skyes shing / rim gyis theg pa gsum gyis sdug bsngal mthar 'byin pa mthong ngo / /rab 'byor ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag ched du bsams te/ sems can dmyal ba chen po dag tu dong zhing sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byas nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang / yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul gsum po de dag gis sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag la chos ston cing / rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyis sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal de dag zhi bar byas te/ yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis chos ston pa dang / byang

chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen pos chos ston te/ des sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la sems mos par byas shing / sems can dmyal ba chen po de dag nas rnam par ldang ba dang / de dag sems can dmyal ba chen po de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ lha dang myi dag dang skal ba mnyam par skyes shing/ rim gyis theg pa gsum gyis sdug bsngal mthar 'byin pa mthong ngo / /rab 'byor ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis/ 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag ched du bsams te/ sems can dmyal ba chen po dag tu dong zhing / sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byas nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang / yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang /rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul gsum po de dag gis sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag la chos ston cing / rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyis sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal de dag zhi bar byas te/ yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis chos ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen pos chos ston te/ des sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la sems mos par byas shing / sems can dmyal ba chen po de dag nas rnam par ldang ba dang / de dag sems can dmyal ba chen po de dag nas/ rnam par langs nas/ lha

dang mye dag dang skal ba mnyam par skyes shing / rim gyis theg pa gsum gyis sdug bsngal mthar 'byin pa mthong ngo / /rab 'byor ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi sbyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag ched du bsams te/ sems can dmyal ba chen po dag tu dong zhing / sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byas nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang / yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul gsum po de dag gis sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag la chos ston cing / rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyis sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal de dag zhi bar byas te/ yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis chos ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen pos chos ston te/ des sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la/ sems mos par byas shing / sems can dmyal ba chen po de dag nas rnam par ldang ba dang / de dag sems can dmyal ba chen po de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ lha dang myi dag dang skal ba mnyam par skyes shing / rim gyis theg pa gsum gyis sdug bsngal mthar 'byin pa mthong ngo / /rab 'byor ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa'

chen po dag ched du bsams te/ sems can dmyal ba chen po dag tu dong zhing / sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byas nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang / yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul gsum po de dag gis sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag la chos ston cing / rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyis sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal de dag zhi bar byas te/ yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis chos ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen pos chos ston te/ des sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la sems mos par byas shing / sems can dmyal ba chen po de dag nas rnam par ldang ba dang / de dag sems can dmyal ba chen po de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ lha dang myi dag dang skal ba mnyam par skyes shing / rim gyis breg pa gsum gyis sdug bsngal mthar 'byin pa mthong ngo / /rab 'byor ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag ched du bsams te/ sems can dmyal ba chen po dag tu dong zhing / sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byas nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang / yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul gsum po de dag gis sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag la chos ston cing / rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyis sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal de dag zhi bar byas te/ yongs su bstan

pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis chos ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen pos chos ston te/ des sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la sems mos par byas shing / sems can dmyal ba chen po de dag nas/ rnam par ldang ba dang / de dag sems can dmyal ba chen po de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ lha dang myi dag dang skal ba mnyam par skyes shing / rim gyis theg pa gsum gyis sdug bsngal mthar 'byin pa mthong ngo / /rab 'byor ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag ched du bsams te/ sems can dmyal ba chen po dag tu dong zhing / sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byas nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang / yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul gsum po de dag gis sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag la chos ston cing / rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyis sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal de dag zhi bar byas te/ yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis chos ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen pos chos ston te/ des sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la sems mos par byas shing / sems can dmyal ba chen po de dag

pa'i sems can rnams kyi don du bdag yongs su gtong ba byed cing / de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag yan lag dang nyid lag bcad cing gtubs te/ phyogs bcur rnam par 'thor ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas pa'i sems can de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag gi sha zos nas/ de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la byams pa 'thob pa dang / de dag byams pa thob pa des byol song gi skye gnas nas rnam par ldang zhing / rnam par langs nas lha dang / myi'i nang du skye ba dang / de dag tu skyes nas kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mnyes par byed pa dang / de dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / de dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag las chos thos te/ de bzhin nyid du nan tan byed pa dang / de dag nyan thos kyi theg pa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa 'am/ theg pa chen po 'am/ theg pa gsum po de dag gis phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su rim gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba mthong ste/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed cing / de bzhin nyid du nan tan byed pa de dag ni de ltar phan pa mang po byed pa'o/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag / byol song gi skye gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyi don du bdag yongs su gtong ba byed cing / de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag yan

las 'da' bar 'gyur ba mthong ste/ rab 'byor de la lha'i bu gang 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas shas cher myos pa de dag la gzhal myed khang de dag 'bar bar snang bar byas shing / de dag skyo bar gyur par shes nas/ 'di skad du grogs po dag 'du byed thams cad ni myi rtag pa/ 'du byed thams cad ni sdug bsngal ba/ 'du byed thams cad ni bdag myed pa/ 'du byed thams cad ni myi brtan pa/ 'du byed thams cad ni yid brtan du myi rung ba/ 'du byed thams cad ni rnam par 'gyur ba'i chos can yin na/ 'du byed rnams la lta su zhig yid phebs par gnas shes chos ston to/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams sems can gang tshangs pa'i lta ba la mngon par zhen pa de dag la/ kye grogs po dag chos thams cad stong pa la ci zhig lta ba skyed/ chos thams cad gsog dang gsob sha stag la ci zhig lta ba skyed ces lta ba'i rnam pa de dag dang bral bar byed pa mthong ste/ rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams snying rje chen po la gnas shing / sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /rab 'byor de ni ngo mtshar che ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rmad du byung ba'i chos so/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams sems can gang tshangs pa'i lta ba la mngon par zhen pa de dag la/ kye grogs po dag chos thams cad stong pa la ci zhig lta ba skyed/ chos thams

mtshar che ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rmad du byung ba'i chos so/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams sems can gang tshangs pa'i lta ba la mngon par zhen pa de dag la/ kye grogs po dag chos thams cad stong pa la ci zhig lta ba skyed/ chos thams cad gsog dang gsob sha stag la ci zhig lta bskyed ces/ lta ba'i rnam pa de dag dang bral bar byed pa mthong ste/ rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams snying rje chen po la gnas shing / sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /rab 'byor de ni ngo mtshar che ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rmad du byung ba'i chos so/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams sems can gang tshangs pa'i lta ba la mngon par zhen pa de dag la/ kye grogs po dag chos thams cad stong pa la ci zhig lta ba skyed/ chos thams cad gsog dang gsob sha stag la ci zhig lta bskyed ces lta ba'i rnam pa de dag dang bral bar byed pa mthong ste/ rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams snying rje chen po la gnas shing sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /rab 'byor de ni ngo mtshar che ste / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rmad du byung ba'i chos so/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/

cad gsog dang gsob sha stag la ci zhig lta ba skyed ces lta ba'i rnam pa de dag dang bral bar byed pa mthong ste/ rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams snying rje chen po la gnas shing / sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /rab 'byor de ni ngo mtshar che ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rmad du byung ba'i chos so/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams sems can gang tshangs pa'i lta ba la mngon par zhen pa de dag la/ kye grogs po dag chos thams cad stong pa la ci zhig lta ba skyed/ chos thams cad gsog dang gsob sha stag la ci zhig lta ba skyed ces lta ba'i rnam pa de dag dang bral bar byed pa mthong ste/ rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams snying rje chen po la gnas shing / sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /rab 'byor de ni ngo mtshar che ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rmad du byung ba'i chos so/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag myi rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sdung ba mthong ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang / tshig snyan pa dang / don spyad pa dang / don mthun pa'o/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig (rtan,rten ) la rnam par gzigs na/ lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po

dag myi rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sdud pa mthong ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang / tshig snyan pa dang / don spyad pa dang / don mthun pa'o/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag myi rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sdud pa mthong ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang / tshig snyan pa dang / don spyad pa dang / don mthun pa'o/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag myi rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sdud pa mthong ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang / tshig snyan pa dang / don spyad pa dang / don mthun pa'o/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag myi rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sdud pa mthong ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang / tshig snyan pa dang / don spyad pa dang / don mthun pa'o/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag myi rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sdud pa mthong ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang/ /tshig snyan pa dang / don spyad pa dang / don mthun pa'o/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams

kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag myi rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sdud pa mthong ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang / tshig snyan pa dang / don spyad pa dang / don mthun pa'o/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag/ myi rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sdud pa mthong ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang / tshig snyan pa dang / don spyad pa dang / don mthun pa'o/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ 'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag myi rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sdud pa mthong ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang / tshig snyan pa dang / don spyad pa dang / don mthun pa'o/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag myi rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sdud pa mthong ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang / tshig snyan pa dang / don spyad pa dang / don mthun pa'o// // shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bzhi pa/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pas sems can rnams sdud pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pa gnyis kyis sems can rnams sdud de/ gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ zang zing sbyin pa dang / chos sbyin pa'o/ /rab

'byor ji ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zang zing gi sbyin pas sems can rnams sdud pa yin zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gser ram/ dngul lam/ nor bu 'am/ mu tig gam/ baiḍūr+ya 'am/ dung ngam/ man shel lam/ byu ru 'am/ sa le sbram mam/ zas sam/ skom mam/ gdugs sam/ gos sam/ spos sam/ 'phreng ba 'am/ byug pa 'am/ mal cha 'am/ stan nam/ 'tsho ba 'am/ bud myed dam/ skyes pa 'am/ rta 'am/ glang po 'am/ bdag po yongs su gtong na/ 'di skad du kye sems can dag tshur shog/ bdag nyid kyi dang 'dra bar bslang myi dgos par khyer cig/ long la dengs shig ces brjod de/ sbyin pa des sbyin pa byin nas/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su gtong ngo / /chos la skyabs su gtong ngo / /dge 'dun la skyabs su gtong ngo / /la la ni bslab pa'i gnas lnga 'dzin tu 'dzud do/ /la la ni yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i nye bar gnas pa la nye bar gnas par byed do/ /la la ni dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams la 'god do/ /la la ni bsam gtan dang po la 'god do/ /la la ni bsam gtan gnyis pa la 'god do/ /la la ni bsam gtan gsum pa la 'god do/ /la la ni bsam gtan bzhi pa la 'god do/ /la la ni byams pa la 'god do/ /la la ni snying rje la 'god do/ /la la ni dga' ba la 'god do/ la la ni btang snyoms la 'god do/ /la la ni nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la 'god do/ /la la ni rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la 'god do/ /la la ni chung zad myed pa'i skye mched la 'god do/ /la la ni 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la 'god do/ /la la ni sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa la yang dag par skul lo/ /la la ni chos rjes su dran pa la yang dag par skul
