stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /dbang po lnga ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /stobs lnga ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /bsam gtan bzhi ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /tshad myed pa bzhi ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos stond to/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /mngon par shes pa lnga ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /ting nge 'dzin thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /gzungs kyi sgo thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /byams pa chen po ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /snying rje chen po ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /dga' ba chen po ni rang bzhin

gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /btang snyoms chen po ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /dgra bcom pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /rang byang chub ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba thams cad spong ba ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos ston to/ /rab 'byor gal te nang stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te phyi stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te phyi nang stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te stong pa nyid stong

pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te chen po stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te don dam pa stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te 'dus byas stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bas bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te rang bzhin stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems

dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te chos thams cad stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ gal te ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur ro/ /gal te dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid rang bzhin gyis stong pa ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar chos bstan par myi 'gyur te/ de'i phyir rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang bshig par 'gyur na/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'jig par myi 'gyur rtag pa ma yin te/ phyis myed par 'gro ba yang ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni yul na myi gnas/ phyogs na myi gnas pa ste/ de ni gang nas kyang 'ong ba yang ma yin/ gang du 'gro ba yang ma yin te/ de ni chos gnas pa nyid do/ /de la ni chos gang yang 'phel bar dmyigs pa'am/ 'grib pa dmyigs pa

'am/ 'gong ba dmyigs pa'am/ skye ba dmyigs pa 'am/ 'byung ba dmyigs pa'am/ 'gag pa dmyigs pa'am/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dmyigs pa 'am/ rnam par byang ba dmyigs pa myed do/ /de ni chos rnams kyi rang bzhin te /de la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par 'jug ste/ chos gang yang 'jug pa 'am/ myi 'jug par mthong ba myed do/ /chos thams cad ni 'jug pa myed cing gnas pa myed pa ste/ de ni chos rnams kyi chos gnas pa'o/ /de bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong par mthong nas/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir myi ldog go/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des sgrib pa'i chos gang yang yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ste/ chos thams cad ni sgrib pa myed par yang dag par rjes su mthong ngo / /de ni 'di ltar rang bzhin stong pa nyid la bdag myi dmyigs/ bdag tu gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ sems can myi dmyigs/ sems can du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ srog myi dmyigs/ srog tu gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ 'gro ba'ang myi dmyigs/ 'gro bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ gso ba yang myi dmyigs/ gso bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ skyes bu yang myi dmyigs/ skyes bur gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ gang zag kyang myi dmyigs/ gang zag tu gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ shed can yang myi dmyigs/ shed can du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ shed bdag kyang myi dmyigs/ shed bdag tu gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ byed pa po yang myi dmyigs/ byed pa por gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ tshor

ba po yang myi dmyigs/ tshor ba por gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ tshor bar byed pa yang myi dmyigs/ tshor bar byed par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ slong ba yang myi dmyigs/ slong bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ kun nas slong ba yang myi dmyigs/ kun nas slong bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ shes pa po yang myi dmyigs/ shes pa por gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ mthong ba po yang myi dmyigs/ mthong ba por gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ gzugs kyang myi dmyigs/ gzugs su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ tshor ba yang myi dmyigs/ tshor bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ 'du shes kyang myi dmyigs/ 'du shes su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ 'du byed kyang myi dmyigs/ 'du byed du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rnam par shes pa yang myi dmyigs/ rnam par shes par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ myig kyang myi dmyigs/ myig tu gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rna ba yang myi dmyigs/ rna bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ sna yang myi dmyigs/ snar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ lce yang myi dmyigs/ lcer gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ lus kyang myi dmyigs/ lus su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ yid kyang myi dmyigs/ yid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ gzugs kyang myi dmyigs/ gzugs su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ sgra yang myi dmyigs/ sgrar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ dri yang myi dmyigs/ drir gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ ro yang myi dmyigs/ ror gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ reg kyang myi dmyigs/ reg tu gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ chos kyang myi dmyigs/ chos su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ myig gi rnam par shes pa yang myi dmyigs/ myig gi rnam par shes

par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yang myi dmyigs/ rna ba'i rnam par shes par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ sna'i rnam par shes pa yang myi dmyigs/ sna'i rnam par shes par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ lce'i rnam par shes pa yang myi dmyigs/ lce'i rnam par shes par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa yang myi dmyigs/ lus kyi rnam par shes par/ gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa/ yang myi dmyigs/ yid kyi rnam par shes par/ gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa yang myi dmyigs/ myig gi 'dus te reg par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yang myi dmyigs/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa yang myi dmyigs/ sna'i 'dus te reg par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa yang myi dmyigs/ lce'i 'dus te reg par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yang myi dmyigs/ lus kyi 'dus te reg par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yang myi dmyigs/ yid kyi 'dus te reg par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang myi dmyigs/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang myi dmyigs/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang myi dmyigs/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang myi dmyigs/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor

bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang myi dmyigs/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang myi dmyigs/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ sa'i khams kyang myi dmyigs/ sa'i khams su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ chu'i khams kyang myi dmyigs/ chu'i khams su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ mye'i khams kyang myi dmyigs/ mye'i khams su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rlung gi khams kyang myi dmyigs/ rlung gi khams su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ nam mkha'i khams kyang myi dmyigs/ nam mkha'i khams su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rnam par shes pa'i khams kyang myi dmyigs/ rnam par shes pa'i khams su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ ma rig pa yang myi dmyigs/ ma rig par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ 'du byed kyang myi dmyigs/ 'du byed du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rnam par shes pa yang myi dmyigs/ rnam par shes par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ mying dang gzugs kyang myi dmyigs/ mying dang gzugs su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ skye mched drug kyang myi dmyigs/ skye mched drug tu gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ reg pa yang myi dmyigs/ reg par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ tshor ba yang myi dmyigs/ tshor bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ sred pa yang myi dmyigs/ sred par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ len pa yang myi dmyigs/ len par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ srid pa yang myi dmyigs/ srid par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ skye ba yang myi dmyigs/ skye

bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rga shi yang myi dmyigs/ rga shir gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ bsam gtan kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyind par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ nang stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ nang stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ phyi stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ phyi stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ phyi nang stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ chen po stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ chen po stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ don dam pa stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ thog ma dang tha

ma myed pa stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ dran pa nye bar gzhag par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ yang dag par spong bar gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ dbang po rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ dbang por gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ stobs rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ stobs su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ byang chub kyi yan lag tu gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yang myi dmyigs/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ 'phags pa'i bden pa

rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ 'phags pa'i bden par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ bsam gtan rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ bsam gtan du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ tshad myed pa rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ tshad myed par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rnam par thar pa rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ rnam par thar par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yang myi dmyigs/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ mngon par shes par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ ting nge 'dzin du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ gzungs kyi sgor gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ myi 'jigs pa rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ myi 'jigs par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ so so yang dag par rig par rnams kyang myi dmyigs/ so so yang dag par rig par gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ byams pa chen po yang myi dmyigs/ byams pa chen por gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ snying rje chen po yang myi dmyigs/ snying rje chen por gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad kyang myi dmyigs/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres

pa bcwo brgyad du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yang myi dmyigs/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bur gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang myi dmyigs/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bur gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang myi dmyigs/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bur gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ dgra bcom pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ dgra bcom pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rang byang chub kyang myi dmyigs/ rang byang chub tu gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyang myi dmyigs/ myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis su gdags pa yang myi dmyigs/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu yang myi dmyigs/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cur gdags pa yang myi dmyigs na bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la the tshom za bar 'gyur ba lta ga las 'ong / rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pas sprul pa'i dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma 'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma la bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong / du mar rgyun tu/ chos bstan na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ sprul pa de dag la rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu rjes su thob par 'gyur ba'i skal ba lta yod dam/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'am/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid dam/ rang byang chub bam/ bla na myed pa yang dag par

rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ba'i skal ba yod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags te/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag la dngos po ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ chos thams cad la dngos po myed na sems can gang zhig byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu 'am/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'am/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid dam/ rang byang chub bam/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu dgod par bya ste/ gzhan du na phyin ci log gis yongs su 'khris pa'i skye dgu dag phyin ci log myed pa la gzhog go/ /'dul lo/ /rab tu 'god do/ /phyin ci log gang yin pa de yang rtog pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i phyir/ phyin ci log ma yin pa ste/ rnam par rtog pa myed pa ni phyin ci log ma yin pa'o/ /gang la phyin ci log myed pa de la bdag myed do/ /sems can myed do/ /srog myed do/ /'gro ba myed do/ /gso ba myed do/ /skyes bu myed do/ /gang zag myed do/ /shed can myed do/ /shed bdag myed do/ /byed pa po myed do/ /tshor ba po myed do/ /shes pa po myed do/ /mthong ba po myed do/ /de la gzugs myed do/ /tshor ba myed do/ /'du shes myed do/ /'du byed myed do/ /rnam par shes pa myed do/ /de la myig myed do/ /rna ba myed do/ /sna myed do/ /lce myed do/ /lus myed do/ /yid myed do/ /de la gzugs myed do/ /sgra myed do/ /dri myed do/ /ro myed do/ /reg myed do/ /chos myed do/ /de la myig gi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /de la myig gi 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg

pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /de la myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /de la sa'i khams myed do/ /chu'i khams myed do/ /mye'i khams myed do/ /rlung gi khams myed do/ /nam mkha'i khams myed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams myed do/ /de la ma rig pa bya myed do/ /'du byed myed do/ /rnam par shes pa myed do/ /mying dang gzugs myed do/ /skye mched drug myed do/ /reg pa myed do/ /tshor ba myed do/ /sred pa myed do/ /len pa myed do/ /srid pa myed do/ /skye ba myed do/ /rga shi myed do/ /de la sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rold tu phyin da pa myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /de la nang stong pa nyid myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /de la dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams

myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams myed do/ /dbang po rnams myed do/ /stobs rnams myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed do/ /de la 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams myed do/ bsam gtan rnams myed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams myed do/ /de la rnam par thar pa rnams myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa myed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams myed do/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams myed do/ /byams pa chen po myed do/ /snying rje chen po myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad myed do/ /de la rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu myed do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid myed do/ /rang byang chub myed do/ /de la lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myed do// // shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu pa/ /gang la gzugs myed pa dang / tshor ba myed pa dang / 'du shes myed pa dang / 'du byed myed pa dang / rnam par shes pa myed pa dang / gang la myig myed pa dang / rna ba myed pa dang / sna myed pa dang / lce myed pa dang / lus myed pa dang / yid myed pa dang / gang la gzugs myed pa dang / sgra med pa dang / dri myed pa dang / ro myed pa dang / reg myed pa dang / chos myed pa dang / gang la myig gi rnam par shes pa

myed pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa myed pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa myed pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa myed pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa myed pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa myed pa dang / gang la myig gi 'dus te reg pa myed pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa myed pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa myed pa dang / gang la myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed pa dang / gang la sa'i khams myed pa dang / chu'i khams myed pa dang / mye'i khams myed pa dang / rlung gi khams myed pa dang / nam mkha'i khams myed pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams myed pa dang / gang la ma rig pa myed pa dang / 'du byed myed pa dang / rnam par shes pa myed pa dang / mying dang gzugs myed pa dang / skye mched drug myed pa dang / reg pa myed pa dang / tshor ba myed pa dang / sred pa myed pa dang / len pa myed pa dang / srid pa myed pa dang / skye ba myed pa dang / rga shi myed pa dang / gang la sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa dang / gang la nang stong pa nyid myed pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid myed pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid myed pa dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid myed pa dang / chen

po stong pa nyid myed pa dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid myed pa dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid myed pa dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid myed pa dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid myed pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid myed pa dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid myed pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid myed pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid myed pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid myed pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid myed pa dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid myed pa dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed pa dang / gang la dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams myed pa dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams myed pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams myed pa dang / dbang po rnams myed pa dang / stobs rnams myed pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams myed pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed pa dang / gang la 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams myed pa dang / bsam gtan rnams myed pa dang / tshad myed pa rnams myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams myed pa dang / gang la rnam par thar pa brgyad myed pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams myed pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa myed pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams myed pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams myed pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams myed pa dang / gang la de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams myed pa dang / myi 'jigs pa rnams myed pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams myed pa dang / byams pa chen po myed pa dang / snying rje chen po myed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad myed pa dang / gang la rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu myed pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed pa dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed pa dang / dgra bcom

pa nyid myed pa dang / rang byang chub myed pa dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myed pa dang / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub myed pa de ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid de/ de la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sems can phyin ci log tu gyur pa rnams sems can gyi 'du shes las 'grel te/ gzugs kyi 'du shes las 'grel to/ /gzugs myed pa'i 'du shes las 'grel to/ /zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos thams cad kyi bar las 'grel to/ /gang zag pa myed pa'i chos 'di lta ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad po de dag kyang de la don dam pa'i rnam pa gang yin pa de lta bu ma yin te/ 'di ltar 'dus ma byas pa dang / ma skyes pa dang / dngos po myed pa dang / 'byung ba myed pa 'di ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /de ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi byang chub ste/ de la bdag myed do/ /sems can myed do/ /srog myed do/ /skye ba po myed do/ /gso ba myed do/ /skyes bu myed do/ /gang zag myed do/ /shed can myed do/ /shed bdag myed do/ /byed pa po myed do/ /tshor ba po myed do/ /shes pa po myed do/ /mthong ba po

myed do/ /gzugs myed do/ /tshor ba myed do/ /'du shes myed do/ /'du byed myed do/ /rnam par shes pa myed do/ /myig myed do/ /rna ba myed do/ /sna myed do/ /lce myed do/ /lus myed do/ /yid myed do/ /gzugs myed do/ /sgra myed do/ /dri myed do/ /ro myed do/ /reg myed do/ /chos myed do/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /sa'i khams myed do/ /chu'i khams myed do/ /mye'i khams myed do/ /rlung gi khams myed do/ /nam mkha'i khams myed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams myed do/ /ma rig pa myed do/ /'du byed myed do/ /rnam par shes pa myed do/ /mying dang gzugs myed do/ /skye mched drug myed do/ /reg pa myed do/ /tshor ba myed do/ /sred pa myed do/ /len pa myed do/ /srid pa myed do/ /skye ba myed do/ /rga shi myed do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyind pa myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /nang stong pa nyid myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa

nyid myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams myed do/ /dbang po rnams myed do/ /stobs rnams myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams myed do/ /bsam gtan rnams myed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams myed do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa myed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi myed do/ /byams pa chen po myed do/ /snying rje chen po myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad myed do/ /myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis myed do/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu myed do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu myed do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed do/ /dgra bcom pa

nyid myed do/ /rang byang chub myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni gzhan du na/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid yongs su shes pa las lam gyi don du/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'jug pa myed de/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid de yang snga nas kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid phyin chad kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid bar du yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid de/ de nam yang rang bzhin gyis myi stong pa ma yin no/ /de bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sems can du 'du shes pa'i sems can rnams kyi sems can gyi 'du shes yongs su dgrol ba'i phyir lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la spyod do/ /de lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ 'di lta ste/ nyan thos kyi lam dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi lam dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang / lam thams cad la spyod de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de lam thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byas/ sems can yongs su smin par byas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byas nas/ tshe'i 'du byed byin gyis brlabs te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /de bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi tshul rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi rgyun myi gcod do/ /de ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi tshul te/ 'das pa'i dus kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig byung ba de dag gi sangs rgyas kyi tshul yang 'di lta ste/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sangs rgyas bcom ldan

'das gang ji snyed cig 'byung bar 'gyur ba de dag gi sangs rgyas kyi tshul yang 'di lta ste/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /da ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig/ bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag gi sangs rgyas kyi tshul yang 'di lta ste/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ma gtogs par gzhan las 'jig rten du 'byung bar myi 'gyur ro/ /de bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad par bya ste/ de la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las yongs su nyam par myi 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi chos thams cad la spyod cing / gzugs kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /tshor ba yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /'du shes kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /'du byed kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rnam par shes pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /myig kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rna ba yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /sna yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /lce yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /lus kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /yid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /gzugs kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /sgra yang gzhan no/ /rang

bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /dri yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /ro yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /reg kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /chos kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa

nyid kyang gzhan no/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /sa'i khams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /chu'i khams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /mye'i khams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rlung gi khams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /nam mkha'i khams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /ma rig pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /'du byed kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rnam par shes pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /mying dang gzugs kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /skye mched drug kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /reg pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /tshor ba yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /sred pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /len pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /srid pa yang gzhan no/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /skye ba yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rga shi yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /bsam

gtan kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /nang stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /phyi stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang gzhan no/ /

rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /dbang po rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /stobs rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /bsam gtan rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /tshad myed pa rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /mngon par shes pa rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi yang

gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /byams pa chen po yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /snying rje chen po yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /dgra bcom pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang byang chub kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /lam kyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan no/ /zhes bgyi bar rang bzhin stong pa nyid rnam par 'khrug par myi bgyid kyi gzugs nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzugs so/ /tshor ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang tshor ba'o/ /'du shes nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang 'du shes so/ /'du byed nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang 'du byed do/ /rnam par shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rnam par shes pa'o/ /myig nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang myig go/ /rna ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rna ba'o/ /sna nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang sna'o/ /lce nyid kyang rang bzhin stong

pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang lce'o/ /lus nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang lus so/ /yid nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang yid do/ /gzugs nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzugs so/ /sgra nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang sgra'o/ /dri nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dri'o/ /ro nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang ro'o/ /reg nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang reg go/ /chos nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang chos so/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang myig gi rnam par shes pa'o/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'o/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang sna'i rnam par shes pa'o/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang lce'i rnam par shes pa'o/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang lus kyi rnam par shes pa'o/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang yid kyi rnam par shes pa'o/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang myig gi 'dus te reg pa'o/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'o/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang sna'i 'dus te reg

pa'o/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang lce'i 'dus te reg pa'o/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'o/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'o/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'o/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'o/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'o/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'o/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'o/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'o/ /sa'i khams nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang sa'i khams so/ /chu'i khams nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang chu'i khams so/ /mye'i khams nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang mye'i khams so/ /rlung gi khams nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rlung gi khams so/ /nam mkha'i khams nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin

stong pa nyid kyang nam mkha'i khams so/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rnam par shes pa'i khams so/ /ma rig pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang ma rig pa'o/ /'du byed nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang 'du byed do/ /rnam par shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rnam par shes pa'o/ /mying dang gzugs nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang mying dang gzugs so/ /skye mched drug nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang skye mched drug go/ /reg pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang reg pa'o/ /tshor ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang tshor ba'o/ /sred pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang sred pa'o/ /len pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang len pa'o/ /srid pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang srid pa'o/ /skye ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang skye ba'o/ /rga shi nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rga shi'o/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang

bzhin stong pa nyid kyang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nang stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang nang stong pa nyid do/ /phyi stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang phyi stong pa nyid do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang phyi nang stong pa nyid do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang stong pa nyid stong pa nyid do/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang chen po stong pa nyid do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang don dam pa stong pa nyid do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang 'dus byas stong pa nyid do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid

kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang chos thams cad stong pa nyid do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams so/ /yang dag par spong ba nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang yang dag par spong ba rnams so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams so/ /dbang po nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dbang po rnams so/ /stobs nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang stobs rnams so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang byang chub kyi yan lag rnams so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'o/ /'phags pa'i bden pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams so/ /bsam gtan nyid kyang rang

bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang bsam gtan rnams so/ /tshad myed pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang tshad myed pa rnams so/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams so/ /rnam par thar pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rnam par thar pa rnams so/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams so/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'o/ /mngon par shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang mngon par shes pa rnams so/ /ting nge 'dzin nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ /gzungs kyi sgo nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzungs kyi sgo rnams so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams so/ /myi 'jigs pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang myi 'jigs pa rnams so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang so so yang dag par rig pa rnams so/ /byams pa chen po nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang byams pa chen po'o/ /snying rje chen

po nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang snying rje chen po'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /dgra bcom pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dgra bcom pa nyid do/ /rang byang chub nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rang byang chub bo/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do/ /zhes bgyi bar spyod pa ngo mtshar che'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ ji skad du smras pa bzhin te/ /rab 'byor gal te gzugs kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ tshor ba yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ 'du shes kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ 'du byed kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rnam par shes pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ myig kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rna ba yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ sna yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong

pa nyid kyang gzhan/ lce yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ lus kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ yid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ gzugs kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ sgra yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ dri yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ ro yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ reg kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ chos kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ myig gi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ sna'i rnam par shes pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ lce'i rnam par shes pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen

kyis tshor ba yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ sa'i khams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ chu'i khams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ mye'i khams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rlung gi khams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ nam mkha'i khams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rnam par shes pa'i khams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ ma rig pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ 'du byed kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rnam par shes pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ mying dang gzugs kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ skye mched drug kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ reg pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ tshor ba yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ sred pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ len pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ srid pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ skye ba yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rga shi yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan

la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ nang stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ phyi stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ chen po stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid

kyang gzhan/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ dbang po rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ stobs rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ bsam gtan rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ tshad myed pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rnam par thar pa brgyad kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ myi 'jigs pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong

pa nyid kyang gzhan/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ byams pa chen po yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ snying rje chen po yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ dgra bcom pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rang byang chub kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan te/ gal te gzugs rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir gzugs rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzugs rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te tshor ba rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir tshor ba rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshor ba rang

bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te 'du shes rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir 'du shes rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'du shes rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te 'du byed rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir 'du byed rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'du byed rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te rnam par shes pa rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir rnam par shes pa rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par shes pa rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te myig rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems

dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir myig rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myig rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te rna ba rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir rna ba rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rna ba rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te sna rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir sna rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sna rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te lce rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir lce rang bzhin gyis stong bas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lce rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu

mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te lus rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir lus rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lus rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te yid rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ / rab 'byor gang gi phyir yid rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yid rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te gzugs rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir gzugs rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzugs rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bya bar khong du chud par byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gal te sgra rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhig ma yin na ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya ste/ rab 'byor gang gi phyir sgra rang bzhin gyis stong pas na/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgra rang bzhin

'khrug par myi byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams stong pa'am/ 'on tam myi stong zhes bya bar rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu stong ba'am/ 'on tam myi stong zhes bya bar rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu stong pa'am/ 'on tam myi stong zhes bya bar rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu stong pa'am/ 'on tam myi stong zhes bya bar rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid stong pa'am/ 'on tam myi stong zhes bya bar rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang byang chub stong pa'am/ 'on tam myi stong zhes bya bar rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub stong pa'am/ 'on tam myi stong zhes bya bar rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni gzugs so/ /'di ni gzugs kyi stong pa nyid do zhes gzugs rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni tshor ba'o/ /'di ni tshor ba'i stong pa nyid do zhes tshor ba rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni 'du shes so/ /'di ni 'du shes kyi stong pa nyid do zhes 'du shes rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni 'du byed do/ /'di ni 'du byed kyi stong pa nyid do zhes 'du byed rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni rnam par shes pa'o/ /'di ni rnam par shes pa'i stong pa nyid do zhes rnam par shes pa rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni myig go/ /'di ni myig gi stong pa nyid do zhes myig rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni rna ba'o/ /'di ni rna ba'i stong pa nyid do zhes rna ba rnam par 'khrug par

myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni sna'o/ /'di ni sna'i stong pa nyid do zhes sna rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni lce'o/ /'di ni lce'i stong pa nyid do zhes lce rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni lus so/ /'di ni lus kyi stong pa nyid do zhes lus rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni yid do/ /'di ni yid kyi stong pa nyid do zhes yid rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni gzugs so/ /'di ni gzugs kyi stong pa nyid do zhes gzugs rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni sgra'o/ /'di ni sgra'i stong pa nyid do zhes sgra rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni dri'o/ /'di ni dri'i stong pa nyid do zhes dri rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni ro'o/ /'di ni ro'i stong pa nyid do/ /zhes ro rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni reg go/ /'di ni reg gi stong pa nyid do zhes reg rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni chos so/ /'di ni chos kyi stong pa nyid do zhes chos rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni myig gi rnam par shes pa'o/ /'di ni myig gi rnam par shes pa'i stong pa nyid do zhes myig gi rnam par shes pa rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'o/ /'di ni rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i stong pa nyid do zhes rna ba'i rnam par shes pa rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni sna'i rnam par shes pa'o/ /'di ni sna'i rnam par shes pa'i stong pa nyid do zhes sna'i rnam par shes pa rnam par 'khrug par

myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni lce'i rnam par shes pa'o/ /'di ni lce'i rnam par shes pa'i stong pa nyid do zhes lce'i rnam par shes pa rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni lus kyi rnam par shes pa'o/ /'di ni lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i stong pa nyid do zhes lus kyi rnam par shes pa rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni yid kyi rnam par shes pa'o/ /'di ni yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i stong pa nyid do zhes yid kyi rnam par shes pa rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa'o/ /'di ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i stong pa nyid do zhes myig gi 'dus te reg pa rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'o/ /'di ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i stong pa nyid do zhes rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa'o/ /'di ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i stong pa nyid do zhes sna'i 'dus te reg pa rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni lce'i 'dus te reg pa'o/ /'di ni lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i stong pa nyid do zhes lce'i 'dus te reg pa rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'o/ /'di ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i stong pa nyid do zhes lus kyi 'dus te reg pa rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'o/ /'di ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i stong pa nyid do zhes yid kyi 'dus te reg pa rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba'o/ /'di ni myig

gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba'i stong pa nyid do zhes myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba'o/ /'di ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba'i stong pa nyid do zhes rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba'o/ /'di ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba'i stong pa nyid do zhes sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba'o/ /'di ni lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba'i stong pa nyid do zhes lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba'o/ /'di ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba'i stong pa nyid do zhes lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba'o/ /'di ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba'i stong pa nyid do zhes yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni sa'i khams so/ /'di ni sa'i khams kyi stong pa nyid do zhes sa'i khams rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni chu'i khams so/ /'di ni chu'i khams kyi stong pa nyid do zhes chu'i khams rnam par 'khrug par myi byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni 'di ni mye'i khams so/ /'di
