rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid dgra bcom pa rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid lags na/ bcom ldan 'das mtshan nyid myi 'dra ba'i chos 'di lta ste/ gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa dang / myig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid dang / gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg dang / chos dang / myig gi rnam par shes pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / sa'i khams dang / chu'i khams dang / mye'i khams dang / rlung gi khams dang / nam mkha'i khams dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i yan lag dang / 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / lta ba'i rnam pa

thams cad dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs mkhas pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong ba nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / mngon par shes pa lnga dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs

bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad dang / myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang / 'dus byas kyi khams dang / 'dus ma byas kyi khams te/ bcom ldan 'das chos de dag ni kun kyang gcig dang gcig tu myi 'dra ba/ gcig las gcig 'das pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar gzugs kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan la/ tshor ba'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ 'du shes kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ 'du byed kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan te/ myig gi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rna ba'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ sna'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ lce'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ lus kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ yid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ gzugs kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ sgra'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ dri'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ ro'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ reg gi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ chos kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ myig gi rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ sna'i rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ lce'i rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid kyang

gzhan/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ sa'i khams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ chu'i khams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ mye'i khams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rlung gi khams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ nam mkha'i khams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ ma rig pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ 'du byed kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ mying dang gzugs kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ skye mched drug gi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ reg pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ tshor ba'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ sred pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ len pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ srid pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ skye ba'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rga shi'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ 'dod chags kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ zhe sdang gi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ gti mug gi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ lta ba'i rnam pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/

brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ nang stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ phyi stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ chen po stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ dbang po rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ stobs rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ bsam gtan rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ tshad myed pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/

rnam par thar pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ byams pa chen po'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ snying rje chen po'i chos nyid kyang gzhan/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ myi chen po'i mtshan rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ dpe byad bzang po rnams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ 'dus byas kyi khams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan/ 'dus ma byas kyi khams kyi chos nyid kyang gzhan na/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar mtshan nyid myi 'dra ba'i chos rnams kyi chos nyid mtshan nyid gcig par 'gyur ba lags/ chos rnam par dgod par ni ji ltar 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gang la gnas shing chos rnams tha dad du bgyid pa lags/ chos rnams tha dad du ma bgyis par ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa la spyod par myi nus na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sa nas sar 'phar zhing skyon myed par 'jug pa lags/ ji ltar skyon myed par

zhugs nas/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las 'das te/ mngon par shes pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyid pa lags/ ji ltar mngon par shes pas rnam par rtse zhing sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rold tu phyind pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rold tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba dang / de dag la rnam par rtse bas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mchi ba lags/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la bsnyen bkur bgyid pa lags/ de dag tu yang dge ba'i rtsa ba skyed pa lags/ dge ba'i rtsa ba des sems can rnams yongs su smyin par bgyid pa lags/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su 'dzin pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byord gang 'di skad du de ste/ chos thams cad kyi chos mnyam pa nyid gang yin pa de nyid so so'i skye bo rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid de/ de nyid dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid brgyad pa rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid rgyun tu zhus pa rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid phyir myi 'ong ba rnams kyi chos

mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid dgra bcom pa rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid/ de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid yin na/ mtshan nyid myi 'dra ba'i chos rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid ji ltar mtshan nyid gcig par 'gyur zhes zer ba ni/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ gzugs kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ tshor ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ 'du shes kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ 'du byed kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ myig gi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rna ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ sna'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ lce'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ lus kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ yid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ gzugs kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ sgra'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ dri'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ ro'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ reg gi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ chos kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ myig gi rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid

stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ sna'i rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa/ de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ lce'i rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ sa'i khams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ chu'i khams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/

mye'i khams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rlung gi khams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ nam mkha'i khams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ ma rig pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ 'du byed kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ mying dang gzugs kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ skye mched drug gi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ reg pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ tshor ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ sred pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ len pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ srid pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ skye ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rga shi'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ tshul khrims kyi pha rold tu phyind pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid

stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ nang stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ phyi stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ chen po stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de

nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ dbang po rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ stobs (rnam ,rnams )kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ bsam gtan rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ tshad myed pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rnam par thar pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin

nam/ snying rje chen po'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ dgra bcom pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rang byang chub kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ dgra bcom pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid gang yin pa de nyid stong pa nyid ma yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni stong pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'o na stong pa nyid la/ gzugs kyi mtshan nyid dam/ tshor ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ 'du shes kyi mtshan nyid dam/ 'du byed kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ myig gi mtshan nyid dam/ rna ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ sna'i

mtshan nyid dam/ lce'i mtshan nyid dam/ lus kyi mtshan nyid dam/ yid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ gzugs kyi mtshan nyid dam/ sgra'i mtshan nyid dam/ dri'i mtshan nyid dam/ ro'i mtshan nyid dam/ reg gi mtshan nyid dam/ chos kyi mtshan nyid dam/ myig gi rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ sna'i rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ lce'i rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ sa'i khams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ chu'i khams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ mye'i khams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rlung gi khams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ ma rig pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ 'du byed kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ mying dang gzugs kyi mtshan nyid dam/ skye mched drug gi

mtshan nyid dam/ reg pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ tshor ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ sred pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ len pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ srid pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ skye ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ rga shi'i mtshan nyid dam/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ nang stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ phyi stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ chen po stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ dbang po rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ stobs rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ byang chub kyi yan

lag rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ bsam gtan rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ tshad myed pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rnam par thar pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ snying rje chen po'i mtshan nyid dam/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid dam/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid dam/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid dam/ dgra bcom pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rang byang chub kyi mtshan nyid dam/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dam/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i mtshan nyid dam/ dgra bcom pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan nyid dam/ byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan nyid dam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan nyid dam/ chos kyi mtshan nyid tha dad par 'gyur ba de lta

bu'i chos gang yang dmyigs sam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de lta bas na rnam grangs des 'di ltar rig par bya ste/ chos thams cad kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de la yang so so'i skye bo myed/ so so'i skye bo las gud na yang de myed/ de la yang dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba myed/ dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba las gud na yang de myed/ de la yang chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba myed/ chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba las gud na yang de myed/ de la yang brgyad pa myed/ brgyad pa las gud na yang de myed/ de la yang rgyun tu zhugs pa myed/ rgyun tu zhugs pa las gud na yang de myed/ de la yang lan cig phyir 'ong ba myed/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba las gud na yang de myed/ de la yang phyir myi 'ong ba myed/ phyir myi 'ong ba las gud na yang de myed/ de la yang dgra bcom pa myed/ dgra bcom pa las gud na yang de myed/ de la yang rang sangs rgyas myed/ rang sangs rgyas las gud na yang de myed/ de la yang byang chub sems dpa' myed/ byang chub sems dpa' las gud na yang de myed/ de la yang de bzhin gshegs pa myed/ de bzhin gshegs pa las gud na yang de myed par rig par bya'o/ /gsol pa/ chos nyid de 'dus bgyis pa lags sam/ 'dus ma bgyis pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ni 'dus byas kyang ma yin/ 'dus ma byas kyang ma yin te/ 'dus byas las gud na yang 'dus ma byas dmyigs su myed de/ /'dus ma byas las gud na yang 'dus byas dmyigs su myed de/ rab 'byor de ltar 'dus byas kyi khams gang yin pa dang / 'dus ma byas kyi khams gang yin pa'i chos de gnyis ka yang ldan pa yang ma yin/ myi ldan pa yang ma yin te/ gzugs myed pa bstan du myed pa/ thogs pa myed pa/ mtshan nyid gcig pa ste/ 'di ltar mtshan nyid myed pa'o/ /

de yang de bzhin gshegs pas 'jig rten gyi tha snyad du brjod kyi/ don dam par ni ma yin te/ don dam pa la lus kyi 'du byed dam/ ngag gi 'du byed dam/ yid kyi 'du byed myed de/ lus kyi 'du byed dang / ngag gi 'du byed dang / yid kyi 'du byed las gud na yang don dam pa dmyigs su myed do/ /'on kyang 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams kyi chos mnyam pa nyid gang yin pa de ni don dam pa ste/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ don dam pa las kyang myi g.yo la/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yang byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u bdun cu gcig go/ //de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid ni rang bzhin gyis stong pa ste/ de'i slad du chos gang la yang gang yang ci yang bgyid pa ma mchis na/ de ltar chos thams cad ci yang bgyid pa ma mchis shing / ci yang ma lags pa ci ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ don dam pa las kyang myi g.yo la/ sbyin pa dang / tshig snyan pa dang / don bgyi ba dang / don mthun pas kyang sems can thams cad kyi don bgyid pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ ji skad du smras pa bzhin te/ stong pa nyid gang yin pa de ni gang la yang ci yang byed pa yang myed/ ci yang myi byed pa yang myed de/ gal te sems can 'di dag bdag cag nyid kyis stong pa nyid shes na ni/ de ltar stong pa nyid las kyang myi g.yo la/ sems can rnams kyang bdag gi

'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / bdag gi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / sems can gyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / sems can gyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / srog gi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / srog gi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / 'gro ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / 'gro ba'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / gso ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / gso ba'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / skyes bu'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / skyes bu'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / gang zag gi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / gang zag gi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / shed can gyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / shed can gyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / shed bdag gi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / shed bdag gi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / byed pa po'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / byed pa po'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / tshor ba po'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / tshor ba po'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / shes pa po'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / shes pa po'i 'du shes dang

phral nas stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / mthong ba po'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / mthong ba po'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / gzugs kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / gzugs kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / tshor ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / tshor ba'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / 'du shes kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / 'du shes kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / 'du byed rnams kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / 'du byed rnams kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / myig gi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / myig gi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / rna ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / rna ba'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / sna'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / sna'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / lce'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / lce'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / lus kyi 'du shes dang phral bar byed cing / lus kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba

las 'grel pa dang / yid kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / yid kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / gzugs kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / gzugs kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / sgra'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / sgra'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / dri'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / dri'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / ro'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / ro'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / reg gi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / reg gi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / chos kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / chos kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / myig gi rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / myig gi rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / sna'i rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / lce'i rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang /

lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes

dang bral bar byed cing / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / sa'i khams kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / sa'i khams kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / chu'i khams kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / chu'i khams kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / mye'i khams kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / mye'i khams kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / rlung gi khams kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / rlung gi khams kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid gyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / nam mkha'i khams kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / nam mkha'i khams

kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / ma rig pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / ma rig pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / 'du byed kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / 'du byed kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang bral par byed cing / rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / mying dang gzugs kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / mying dang gzugs kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / skye mched drug gi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / skye mched drug gi 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / reg pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / reg pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / tshor ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / tshor ba'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / sred pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / sred pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / len pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / len pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / srid pa'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / srid pa'i 'du shes dang phral nas/

stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / skye ba'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / skye ba'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / rga shi'i 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / rga shi'i 'du shes dang phral nas/ stong pa nyid kyis 'khor ba las 'grel pa dang / 'dus byas kyi khams kyi 'du shes dang bral bar byed cing / 'dus byas kyi khams kyi 'du shes dang phral nas/ 'dus ma byas kyi dbyings stong pa yin yang / 'dus ma byas kyi dbyings su 'god pa yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i khyu mchog gi mthur mi 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de cis stong pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'du shes thams cad kyis stong ste/ rab 'byor la la zhig gis sprul pa zhig sprul na/ de la gang stong pa nyid ma yin pa de lta bu'i dngos po gang yang yod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /sprul pa de la gang stong pa nyid ma lags pa de lta bu'i dngos po gang yang ma mchis te/ stong pa nyid gang lags pa dang / sprul pa gang lags pa'i chos de gnyis ka yang ldan pa yang ma lags/ mi ldan pa yang ma lags te/de gnyis ka yang stong pa nyid kyis stong na/ de ci'i slad du/ 'di ni stong pa nyid do/ /'di ni sprul pa'o/ /zhes bgyi bar rnam par bcab pa mdzad/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de ni 'di lta ste/ stong pa nyid dang / sprul pa gnyis ka yang stong pa nyid la dmigs su ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gzugs sam/ tshor ba 'am/ 'du shes sam/ 'du byed dam/ rnam par shes pa gang sprul pa ma

yin pa de lta bu yod dam/ gang sprul pa de ni stong pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te 'jig rten pa'i chos sprul pa lags kyang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos 'di lta ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad dang / de dag gi 'bras bu gang gis gang zag rgyun tu zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir myi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes gang zag rnam par dgod pa'i chos de dag kyang sprul pa lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni sprul pa ste/ de la la la ni nyan thos kyis sprul pa'o/ /

la la ni rang sangs rgyas kyis sprul pa'o/ /la la ni byang chub sems dpas sprul pa'o/ /la la ni de bzhin gshegs pas sprul pa'o/ /la la ni nyon mongs pas sprul pa'o/ /la la ni las kyis sprul pa'o/ /rab 'byor rnam grangs des na chos thams cad ni sprul pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang spangs pa zhes bgyi ba/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu 'am/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'am/ phyir myi 'ong 'od ba'i 'bras bu 'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid dam/ rang sangs rgyas kyis 'am/ sangs rgyas kyis 'am/ bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba thams cad spangs pa'i chos de dag thams cad kyang sprul pa lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byord bskyed pa 'am/ bkag pa'i chos gang ci yang rung ste/ de thams cad ni sprul pa'o/ /gsold pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang ma sprul pa'i chos de gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsald pa/ chos gang la skye ba yang myed/ 'gag pa yang med pa de ni ma sprul pa'o/ /gsold pa/ da gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsald pa/ mi mnyam ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ chos de ni ma sprul pa'o/ /gsold pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad du stong pa nyid las kyang myi g.yo la/ gnyis su yang myi dmigs te/ chos gang yang stong pa nyid

ma yind pa de lta bu myed do/ /zhes bka' stsald pa ltar na/ bcom ldan 'das myi mnyam pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa yang sprul par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsald pa/ rab 'byord de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhind te/ rab 'byord chos thams cad ni stong pa ste/ de dag ni nyan thos kyis ma byas/ rang sangs rgyas kyis ma byas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ma byas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis ma byas te/ ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa nyid gang yin pa de ni mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /rab 'byord kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das las dang po pa'i gang zag gis ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa nyid yongs su 'tshal bar bgyi na/ ji ltar gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsald pa/ rab 'byord ci sngon dngos po yod par gyur la/ phyis dngos po myed par 'gyur ba yod dam/ rab 'byord 'di la dngos po yod pa yang med/ dngos po myed pa yang myed/ ngo bo nyid kyang myed/ gzhan gyi dngos po yang myed na/ de la gang yongs su shes par bya ba'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba lta yod par 'gyur re skan// shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ chos nyid myi 'gyur ba bstan pa'i le'u ste/ bdun cu rtsa gnyis so// /
